div.head: VI Atr 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas—biscpas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ mynecena, canonicas ⁊ nunnan—to rihte gecyrran ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
And huruþinga Godes þeowas—biscpas and abbodas, munecas and mynecena, canonicas and nunnan—to rihte gecyrran and regollice libban and for eall Christen folc þingian georne.

and most of all the servants of God—bishops and abbots, monks and nuns, canons and women under religious vows—shall revert to a proper discharge of their duties and live according to their rule, and earnestly intercede for all Christian people.

And indeed, God’s servants—bishops and abbots, male and female monastics, canons and nuns—are to submit to their duty and live according to their rule, and fervently intercede for all Christian people.

und vor allen Dingen sollen Gottesdiener — Bischöfe und Äbte, Mönche und Mönchinnen, Stiftsgeistliche und Nonnen — zur Rechtspflicht umkehren und nach [kanonischer] Regel leben und eifrig für alles Christenvolk Fürbitte thun.

and above all let the servants of God — bishops and abbots, monks and nuns [of a rule], canons and nuns — turn to their duty and live according to the [canonical] rule and pray eagerly for all Christian people.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
